policy: All ten preregistered new bugs are eval; existing Lang-1/3/4 remain dev. Split recorded before inspecting new patch labels or baseline hit ranks. Model/prompt/weights are frozen in B f97c09a. No performance-based removal or replacement.
method_eligibility: Existing production methods or explicit constructors touched by verified fixed-to-buggy patches. Pure field/class changes or unrepresentable added/deleted methods require an explicit structural exclusion; mixed changes retain mapped methods and disclose unmapped changes. Ambiguity stays pending until resolved.
human_review: New labels do not inherit the old pilot human-review confirmation.
